config.title: Berlin Early Morning - FAQ
config.subtitle: What is open before nine, when it actually gets light, and how to get anywhere before the U-Bahn restarts.

items.q: What is there to do in Berlin early in the morning before things open?
items.a: **Everything outdoors, because almost none of it has a gate.** The field of stelae at the Holocaust Memorial is accessible 24 hours a day, Tiergarten and Volkspark Humboldthain never close, and the East Side Gallery is a public pavement. The two best structured options are Tempelhofer Feld, whose gates open at 06:00 from March to September, and a 07:00 swim at Sommerbad Humboldthain. Anything with a ticket desk waits until 08:00 at the earliest.

items.q: What time does it get light in Berlin?
items.a: **It swings by about three and a half hours across the year.** In late June the sun is up at 04:43 with usable light from around 03:53. In late August sunrise is around 06:05 and first light around 05:29. In late December sunrise is 08:15 and it is still dark at 07:30. Berlin sits at 52 degrees north, which is why the difference is so large.

items.q: What is the first U-Bahn in Berlin in the morning?
items.a: **Just after 04:00 on weekday mornings.** At Alexanderplatz the first U2 is at 04:05, the first U5 at 04:07, the first U8 at 04:10 and the first S-Bahn services at 04:02. The last trains the night before leave around 00:50. On Saturday and Sunday mornings, and before public holidays, the U-Bahn and S-Bahn run right through the night, so there is no gap at all.

items.q: How do I get from BER airport into Berlin before five in the morning?
items.a: **The S9 and the FEX airport express both run before the U-Bahn restarts.** On a normal weekday the first S9 out of Flughafen BER leaves at 04:39 and the first FEX to Hauptbahnhof at 04:31, with N7 and X7 buses filling the hours before. The old S45 no longer runs; the second S-Bahn line serving the airport is the S85.

items.q: What time does Tempelhofer Feld open?
items.a: **06:00 from March to September, 07:00 in February, October and November, and 07:30 in January and December.** Closing moves with the season too, from 17:00 in midwinter to 22:30 in June and July. The entrances are locked at the end of the listed hours, though the main gates have revolving exits so you can always leave.

items.q: Which museum in Berlin opens earliest?
items.a: **The DDR Museum, at 09:00, seven days a week including public holidays.** It is opposite the Berliner Dom, about ten minutes from Alexanderplatz, and it is the only central museum on this list that also opens on Mondays. The TV Tower deck and Zoo Berlin also start at 09:00. Museum Island opens at 10:00 and closes on Mondays.

items.q: Can I go swimming in Berlin at seven in the morning?
items.a: **Yes, and it costs 7 euros.** Sommerbad Humboldthain in Gesundbrunnen is a 50 metre outdoor pool that opens at 07:00 Tuesday to Sunday and at 10:00 on Mondays, closing between 20:00 in high summer and 18:00 by early September. Two rules catch visitors out: the 2026 outdoor season ends on 11 September, and everyone aged 14 and over must show an original photo ID at the gate, not a photo of one.
